name: openbb_crypto_search
description:
Search cryptocurrency symbols by name or ticker through the OpenBB Platform (obb.crypto.search).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): query*; provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts fmp only; schema default fmp, but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it).
Keyless alternative: cg_search; prices: openbb_crypto_price. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"query": "ethereum", "provider": "fmp"}
